findings.problem: The user asked for 'Sampling details' inside/under the Sampling Timepoints section, but the schema has no nesting so it is modeled as a sibling 'singleton' group placed immediately before 'timepoints'. This is a presentation compromise, not literal nesting.
findings.fix: Keep group label 'Sampling details' and position it adjacent (immediately before) 'timepoints'. If true visual nesting is later required, that is a frontend heading-style change only, as the design already scopes it. No action required to proceed.

findings.problem: The literal two-row layout ('Cell no' header row + 'Sample weight (mg)' row) is not reproduced; cell identity is carried in per-field labels 'Cell {n} Sample Weight'. Consistent with how the existing 'cells' group renders, but not the user's verbatim table shape.
findings.fix: Acceptable as designed (matches the 'cells' singleton pattern). If the exact two-row label layout is mandatory, it is a bespoke frontend widget and a separate scope item.

findings.where: design.md FR2, FR6 step 1-4 vs _apply_cu30_kedit.py precedent
findings.problem: The cited precedent _apply_cu30_kedit.py asserts byte-equality against an in-memory seed-module definition, whereas this task must base the new definition on the LIVE lims.db row. A copy-paste of the precedent could wrongly use a seed module as the base.
findings.fix: In the author script, base definition on copy.deepcopy(db_row.definition) read from lims.db, apply the FR3 edit, then assert the re-read new row equals json.dumps(that edited dict, sort_keys=True). The design already states this; just do not copy the precedent's seed.definition source verbatim.

hidden, mirrorFrom, footer, headerContext, chart absent from stored A6D JSON.
cells is a singleton holding applied_mg_{n}; sampling_details mirrors this real pattern.

new_version shares the same code; create_template auto-generates the code; no clone-into-chosen-code method exists.
validate_definition runs TemplateDefinition.parse then WorksheetEvaluator.evaluate({},{}); create/update/submit all enforce it.
